native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, monument construction and axe/celt activity form a single mid-window 'communal pulse' decoupled from symbolic and wealth capital: MonumentCount rises from z=-0.46 (3400 BCE) to a peak of z=+0.91 at 3200 BCE - exactly coinciding with the sharp AxesCelts spike to z=+2.60 - then falls back to z=-0.36 by 3000 BCE, while HouseSize declines monotonically from z=+2.05 to ~0 (trend r=-0.89) and correlates negatively with both MonumentCount (-0.35 anchors / -0.40 annual) and AxesCelts; the prestige objects defining symbolic capital stay flat (HatchetSword ~ -0.43, correlation with MonumentCount only ~ +0.28; Dagger constant at -0.58, relationship undefined). Secondary social-capital indices co-move inversely with the surge (CopperGold r = -0.54 to -0.65; Amber nominally positive but nearly constant). Pollen-based land openness declines steadily across the window (anchor-interpolated +1.65 to -1.16; pollen-file SMOOTH_MEAN_100y +0.20 to -1.81) and shows no positive association with the monument/axes pulse (MonumentCount~pollen r ~ 0; AxesCelts~pollen -0.22 to -0.67). Net: as land openness and household size wane, communal monumental effort and axe deposition surge once, peak together at 3200 BCE, and collapse by 3000 BCE - a shift from household/wealth display toward monumental display not driven by agricultural expansion. Descriptive/correlational only (5 independent 100-year bins; the 3200 BCE spike drives much of the trend); no causal claim is made.
native_result.WorkflowB: Parsed all three CSVs with comma-decimal/CRLF/index robustness; verified time_series_data.csv == capital.csv at all 37 shared 100-yr anchor years and verified *_inter is exact piecewise-linear interpolation. Restricted to CE -3400..-3000 (401 annual rows; 5 raw anchor bins). Computed the anchor value table, Pearson+Spearman correlations at both the 5-anchor and 401-annual levels, first-difference (detrended) correlations, +/-100-yr lagged Pearson cross-correlations, per-variable linear trends, 3200 BCE spike diagnostics, and a pollen-file cross-check (SMOOTH_MEAN_100y at anchors). Results in outputs/analysis_results.json; executed script outputs/analysis_symbolic_capital.py.
